translations.web: The sun and moon stood still in the sky, at the light of your arrows as they went, at the shining of your glittering spear.
translations.bsb: Sun and moon stood still in their places at the flash of Your flying arrows, at the brightness of Your shining spear.
translations.kjv: The sun and moon stood still in their habitation: at the light of thine arrows they went, and at the shining of thy glittering spear.
